name: xinjiang-tianchi
prompt: Aerial view of Tianchi Lake (Heavenly Lake) on Bogda Peak in the Tianshan Mountains, Xinjiang, China. Crystal-clear sapphire alpine lake encircled by ancient pine forests and snow-capped jagged peaks, mirror reflections, golden hour soft light, dramatic cumulus clouds, photorealistic, high detail, no people

name: xinjiang-pamir-karakuli
prompt: Karakul Lake on the Pamir Plateau, Xinjiang, China. Vast high-altitude turquoise lake at 3,600 meters reflecting the snow-capped Muztagh Ata mountain (7,546m), Kyrgyz yurts and grazing yaks on the shoreline, brilliant blue sky with wispy clouds, late afternoon golden light, photorealistic, vast and serene, no people

name: xinjiang-hemu-village
prompt: Hemu Village in autumn, Kanas region, Xinjiang, China. Traditional Tuvan log cabins scattered across a meadow, surrounded by birch and larch trees in vivid autumn yellow and orange, distant snow-dusted mountains, sun rays piercing morning mist over the valley, photorealistic, fairy-tale atmosphere

name: norway-geirangerfjord
prompt: Aerial view of Geirangerfjord, Norway, UNESCO World Heritage site. Deep emerald-blue fjord winding between vertical cliffs, the Seven Sisters waterfall cascading down the rock face, small village at the head of the fjord, soft morning mist hovering above water, photorealistic, dramatic perspective

name: norway-lofoten

name: patagonia-torres-del-paine
prompt: Torres del Paine national park, Patagonia, Chile. name: mount-cook-tekapo

name: milford-sound

name: faroe-islands-mulafossur

name: tibet-yamdrok

name: iceland-skogafoss

name: canadian-rockies-moraine
prompt: Moraine Lake at sunrise, Banff National Park, Canadian Rockies. Vivid turquoise glacial lake reflecting the Valley of the Ten Peaks, glowing alpenglow on the snowy summits, dense alpine pine forest hugging the shore, smooth glassy water, photorealistic, no people
